content.text: Let me fix the two issues and return the updated researchQuestions, plan, and candidate.

{"researchQuestions":["Can an autoencoder trained only on benign Modbus TCP captures learn a site-specific baseline that flags traffic deviations, measured against reconstruction error thresholds validated on held-out captures from the same site in Phase 1?","Does the trained model run on embedded hardware within acceptable packet forwarding latency bounds, measured against forwarding performance recorded on the hardware bench during Phase 2?","What traffic window size and encoding settings yield the lowest false-positive rate for BACnet/IP traffic, measured against false-positive counts recorded on normal traffic from the hardware-in-the-loop bench in Phase 3?","Before signing, can the university confirm that SYN-PRJ-0017 SECURE-ICS background IP does not impose third-party obligations on the anomaly detection method to be developed, confirmed by a brief written description tabled at the kick-off meeting?"],"plan":[{"phase":"Phase 1 (Months 1–6): Data preparation and baseline training","work":"Researcher analyses archive captures, prepares Modbus TCP and BACnet/IP data splits, and trains and validates an autoencoder on benign-only traffic from the company archives.","result":"Validated baseline model, dataset split documentation, and a report on window size and encoding settings, delivered at M6."},{"phase":"Phase 2 (Months 7–12): Firmware integration and bench prototype","work":"Company engineers integrate the baseline model into ProtoSense firmware; researcher supports BACnet/IP adaptation; prototype is tested on the hardware-in-the-loop bench with physical PLC simulators running normal traffic.","result":"Prototype firmware image running on bench hardware and a bench test log, delivered at M12."},{"phase":"Phase 3 (Months 13–15): False-positive benchmarking on hardware","work":"Both sides run structured tests on the hardware bench using normal traffic only from PLC simulators; false-positive rate is recorded across traffic window and encoding configurations. Note: if the bench can generate scripted anomalous sequences, both sides should agree on that scope before this phase begins.","result":"Benchmark report with false-positive rate on normal traffic across tested configurations, delivered at M15."},{"phase":"Phase 4 (Months 16–18): Documentation and integration readiness","work":"Researcher documents the method and training procedure; company engineers prepare the integration specification; researcher submits a journal paper describing the full method and results.","result":"Method documentation package, integration specification, and a submitted journal paper, delivered at M18."}],"candidate":""}
